title: ActionReceipt
description: The durable outcome of an action (master plan 11.2): committed or rejected, stable application record IDs, canonical result facts, queued follow-up status, an audit reference and any uncertainty or partial-failure state. Built by the core from the adapter's Commit or Status result and persisted before it is announced. A verified response may claim completion only when a receipt with status committed exists. The model may verbalise a receipt; it cannot create or alter one: no property is 'model'.

preparation_id.description: The PreparedAction this receipt answers. Every receipt has one: nothing commits without a preparation.

capability_id.description: The capability that was committed or rejected.

status.description: The outcome of the action. committed: the host confirmed the commit. rejected: nothing was applied. queued: accepted for asynchronous completion (see follow_up). partial: part of the action was applied (see errors). uncertain: the outcome could not be determined, even by Status; the user is told so and the action is not retried blindly. Decided by the core from the adapter's DeterministicResult and its own recovery; committed is never inferred from anything but a host ok.

records.description: Stable application record IDs the action created, changed or cancelled, from the host's result. Empty when status is rejected.

facts.description: Canonical result facts from the host's result: the only numbers, dates, times, amounts and IDs a response about this outcome may state.

errors.description: Why the action was rejected, partial or uncertain: issues relayed from the host's result plus any the core adds itself (for example uncertain_outcome, expired). Empty exactly when status is committed or queued.

follow_up.description: Status of queued follow-up work the host reported, where applicable. Required when status is queued.

audit_ref.description: Reference to the audit record of the commit attempt.

issued_at.description: When the core persisted the receipt.

allOf.description: A rejected action created nothing, so no record IDs may suggest otherwise.
